title: 9. Both Sides of the Aisle, Likely Outcomes & No-FOMO Action Plan

epigraph.quote: The hardest discipline in portfolio management is selling a stock that is still in a Stage 2 coil because the price has outrun the business.
epigraph.author: Capital Allocation Principle

web_blocks.html: We now synthesize Pass 1 (CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL, kpi_health: PASS_WITH_WATCH) with Pass 2 (₹3,349.40 CMP, 99.32x TTM P/E, weekly Stage 2 / daily Stage 3 pullback). Both sides of the aisle carry genuine merit, so we steelman each case before assigning probability-weighted outcomes and executing our dual verdict.

web_blocks.html: New-Capital Verdict: REJECTED (Rejection Reasons: VALUATION, CASH_FLOW). Under our anti-hedging underwriting discipline, we refuse to hide behind a timid WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT when the math does not work. Even on a pullback to the nearest technical support zone (₹3,282.46–₹3,382.44 around the 10-week EMA), our Base Case valuation (₹2,950.00) sits below the support zone—yielding negative base-case asymmetry. Until either operating margins recover decisively above 17%–18% with >75% CFO/EBITDA conversion or the stock corrects into the ₹2,100–₹2,400 zone (closer to its June 2026 QIP price and 200-day SMA), new capital must stay away.

web_blocks.takeaway: New capital is rejected across all three horizons at ₹3,349.40; re-entry requires either fundamental margin/cash proof or a deep valuation reset.

web_blocks.html: Current Holding Action: EXIT_IMMEDIATELY (70 Shares in Zerodha). Per the verified 13 November 2026 positions ledger, the portfolio currently holds 70 shares of TANFACIND in Zerodha at a cost basis of ₹2,24,192.40 (₹3,202.75/share average cost) and market value of ₹2,34,458.00 (5.46% portfolio weight, unrealized gain of +₹10,265.60 / +4.58%). Holding a 5.46% position in a CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL stock trading at 99.3x P/E with Q2 FY27 OPM at 11.84% and a -10.1% expected return exposes ₹2.34 lakh of capital to sharp multiple compression if support cracks. We recommend exiting all 70 shares cleanly at market (~₹3,349.40) to lock in the +₹10,265.60 profit and redeploy into higher-asymmetry setups.

web_blocks.html: What Would Change This Verdict: We will re-underwrite TANFACIND for new capital only if (1) Q3/Q4 FY27 OPM rebounds above 17%–18% with CFO/EBITDA >75%, or (2) the stock resets to ₹2,100–₹2,400 where support-zone asymmetry exceeds 1.5:1.

book_paragraphs: We have reached the moment of truth. Across Chapters 1 through 6, we kept our eyes strictly off the stock ticker and examined Tanfac Industries on its operational merits. We found a 54-year-old Cuddalore fluorine veteran that Anupam Rasayan and TIDCO have genuinely upgraded—doubling AHF capacity, commissioning India's only Solar-Grade DHF plant backed by a ₹732 Cr Kredence contract, and raising ₹349.41 Cr in equity to build a ₹495 Cr HFC-32 plant. Yet we also found a cyclical margin squeeze—operating profit margin sliding from 28% in late 2024 to 11.84% in Q2 FY27—alongside lagging cash conversion and single-site concentration.

Then in Chapters 7 and 8, we turned on the market screen. The stock trades at ₹3,349.40, or 99.32 times trailing earnings—more than 70% above its June 2026 QIP price and nearly double Navin Fluorine's multiple. When we run the probability-weighted math—25% Bull at ₹4,200, 50% Base at ₹2,950, and 25% Bear at ₹1,950—the expected value comes out to ₹3,012.50, or a minus 10.1% expected return from today's price.

Our anti-hedging rule is simple: when even a pullback to the nearby 10-week EMA support zone leaves your Base Case target below the entry price, you do not hide behind 'wait for support.' You stamp the new-capital verdict REJECTED on Valuation and Cash Flow. For the 70 shares we currently hold in Zerodha—worth ₹2,34,458.00 at a +₹10,265.60 unrealized gain—we recommend EXIT_IMMEDIATELY at market, with ₹3,280.00 as an unconditional closing backstop. We then redeploy 100% into liquid cash while keeping AJMERA at 0% pending daily Stage 2 confirmation, and keep Navin Fluorine on the outside bench at 0% until it pulls back to support.

Finally, let us walk through the exact portfolio math of our exit and redeployment plan so every rupee of your ₹2,34,458.00 position is accounted for. Exiting all 70 shares of TANFACIND in Zerodha at or near ₹3,349.40 locks in a +₹10,265.60 gain (+4.58% over the ₹2,24,192.40 cost basis) and removes a 5.46% portfolio weight whose probability-weighted expected return is -10.1%.

We retain 100% of those freed proceeds (₹2,34,458) in liquid cash, respecting an Indian equity market with narrow breadth and three distribution days. While shortlist candidate AJMERA trades at 15.5x P/E with a 4.40:1 support-zone asymmetry inside ₹124.51–₹132.17, our daily market-facts ledger currently tags it Stage 3 (Topping / Pullback), so we keep it at 0% until the daily trend confirms. Meanwhile, Navin Fluorine stays on our outside watchlist at 0% allocation until it pulls back into its ₹8,554.56–₹9,044.65 support zone. That is disciplined capital allocation: sell 99x cyclicality while it is green, hold cash for breadth, and rotate only into asymmetric value.

To close our monograph, remember why we separate business quality from stock action. We admire what Tanfac Industries has built at Cuddalore since 2022: the Anupam Rasayan partnership, the Solar-Grade DHF import substitution, the ₹732 crore Kredence contract, and the clean post-QIP balance sheet. If the stock ever revisits the ₹2,100–₹2,400 zone—or if HFC-32 and Solar DHF drive verified 18%+ operating margins and >75% CFO/EBITDA conversion—we will happily re-underwrite it.

Today, at ₹3,349.40 and 99.32x trailing earnings, the math is against new capital. Rejecting new buys, exiting our 70 Zerodha shares at a +4.58% gain, holding 60% cash for narrow-breadth protection, and rotating 40% into AJMERA at 15.5x P/E and 4.4:1 asymmetry keeps our portfolio aligned with probability rather than hope.

Our dual verdict is built to be actionable tomorrow morning without second-guessing. New capital stays out—REJECTED on Valuation and Cash Flow. Our existing 70 shares in Zerodha exit cleanly at market (~₹3,349.40) to bank a +₹10,265.60 gain, with ₹3,280.00 as a hard closing backstop if staged. From the freed ₹2,34,458.00, 100% (₹2,34,458) sits in cash to respect narrow market breadth while AJMERA and NAVINFLUOR remain at 0% on watch.

And remember what our 100% capital redeployment table does for portfolio discipline: instead of letting ₹2.34 lakh sit exposed to single-site chemical multiple risk, we bank the +₹10,265.60 gain, hold 100% in liquid cash for narrow-breadth protection, and wait for AJMERA to reclaim daily Stage 2 before deploying.

book_callouts.title: NARRATOR'S REFLECTION
book_callouts.text: Taking a +4.58% gain and walking away from a 100x P/E chemical stock whose margins just halved feels anticlimactic when the chart is still coiling. That quiet discipline is exactly what protects portfolio capital before a cyclical de-rating.
